terco-da-batalha.ter-o-da-batalha-the-ro: Terço da Batalha (The Rosary of Battle)

A modern popular Brazilian devotion for the struggles people actually face - illness, temptation, fear, the long fight for a family or a livelihood. It is prayed on a standard rosary, in plain Portuguese words that ask God for strength and courage, and it ends with the Salve Rainha, the Hail Holy Queen.
terco-da-batalha.accessibility.a-rosary-: A rosary resting in open hands
terco-da-batalha.ter-o-da-batalha-the-ro: The Terço da Batalha is prayed on an ordinary rosary - large beads, small beads, and the cross.
terco-da-batalha.what-this-devotion-is-a: What This Devotion Is - and What It Is Not
The Terço da Batalha is a modern popular devotion from Brazil, shared by

. It is not the official Dominican Rosary, and it is not an official liturgical text of the Church. Popular devotions like this one are the people's way of praying their struggles - legitimate and loved, but they carry no promise of guaranteed results. God remains free; we remain askers.

The Portuguese text below is the source of truth for this page. Every translation is labeled as a translation, and the wording follows the version shared in the source - older variants of this devotion use different lines, and we do not mix them in.
terco-da-batalha.how-to-pray-it.you-need: You need only an ordinary rosary and the intention you are carrying.
terco-da-batalha.how-to-pray-it.hold-the: Hold the struggle in mind. Invite your guardian angel to fight with you.
terco-da-batalha.how-to-pray-it.pray-the: Pray the Sign of the Cross, the Creed, one Our Father, and three Hail Marys (standard texts).
terco-da-batalha.how-to-pray-it.i-shall-: (I shall win this battle...) three times, ending with the Salve Rainha (Hail Holy Queen).
terco-da-batalha.the-prayers.the-origina: The original Portuguese first, as it was shared, then a labeled translation.
terco-da-batalha.the-prayers.deus-do-c-u: Deus do céu, me dê forças. Jesus Cristo, me dê o poder do bem. Nossa Senhora, me dê coragem para esta luta eu vencer. Sem morrer, sem adoecer, sem muito me abater. Deus pode, Deus quer, esta batalha eu hei de vencer.
terco-da-batalha.the-prayers.god-of-heav: God of heaven, give me strength. Jesus Christ, give me the power of good. Our Lady, give me courage to win this fight. Without dying, without falling ill, without being greatly cast down. God can, God wills it - this battle I shall win.
terco-da-batalha.the-prayers.cruz-sagrad: Cruz sagrada seja a minha luz.
terco-da-batalha.the-prayers.eu-hei-de-v: Eu hei de vencer esta batalha em nome do Pai, em nome do Filho e em nome do Espírito Santo. Amém.
terco-da-batalha.the-prayers.i-shall-win: I shall win this battle in the name of the Father, in the name of the Son, and in the name of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

terco-da-batalha.keep-praying.a-battle-p: A battle prayer is strongest inside the ordinary life of prayer. The Rosary is the Church's own school for it.
